{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
sentinel_count = (data['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
total_rows = len(data)

# Log the finding
print(f'customer_age has -1 values: {sentinel_count} out of {total_rows} rows ({(sentinel_count / total_rows) * 100:.1f}%)')

# Also check for invalid values (negative or NaN)
invalid_age = data['customer_age'].apply(lambda x: x < 0 or pd.isna(x)).sum()
print(f'Invalid age entries: {invalid_age}')

# Confirm the data includes all customers in the file
assert len(data) == 900, 'Data does not include all rows from the file'

# Proceed: remove -1 values for mean calculation
valid_ages = data[data['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

print(f'Mean age of valid customers: {mean_age:.2f} years')"}
